Check-In Instructions

Choose your check-in route below

Step 1
Make your way to Highgate
Head to 260 City Walk, Canberra. You will see the Highgate building from the street — look for the distinctive gold artwork on the facade.
Step 2
Enter the building foyer
Head to the building foyer. Swipe the remote fob on the reader to enter through the glass doors.
Step 3
Your keys
Your keyring has two items — a black remote fob and a blue key. The remote fob is used to swipe all readers and access the lift. The blue key opens your apartment door.
Step 4
Take the lift to Level 10
At the lifts, swipe the remote fob on the reader, then press Level 10.
Step 5
Find apartment 58
As you exit the lift on Level 10, apartment 58 is the first door on your right. Use the blue key to open the door.
Step 1
Turn left off Akuna Street into Rabaul Lane
Drive along Akuna Street and turn left into Rabaul Lane as shown. The car park is located behind the building, next to the Nesuto Hotel.
Step 2
Take the first garage entry on the left
Continue down Rabaul Lane and take the first garage entry on the left. Use the remote fob buttons (press 1 & 2 together) to open the garage door.
Step 3
Drive up — follow the road to the LEFT all the way to the top
Once inside, follow the road around to the LEFT and drive all the way up to the top. You will go up multiple ramps. 🔴 Stop at any red traffic lights — ramps 3 and 4 are one-way with traffic lights.
Step 4
This is what the final ramp looks like
After the final ramp you are on Level 4. Park in car space 58.
Step 5
Park in car space 58
Your allocated car space is number 58, clearly marked on the ground on Level 4.
⚠ Important
Do NOT use the lift inside the car park
There is a lift visible inside the car park — do not use it. It will take you to the wrong building. You must use the fire door next to the ramp as shown in the next step.
Step 6
Use the fire door next to the ramp
Walk back toward the ramp and locate the fire door on the right-hand side next to the ramp. This is the correct door to reach the building lifts.
Step 7
Use your blue key to open the fire door
Use the blue key from your keyring to unlock the fire door and enter the Level 4 foyer.
Step 8
Turn left to the building lifts
You are now in the Level 4 foyer. Turn left and head to the building lifts.
Step 9
Take the lift to Level 10
Swipe the remote fob on the reader inside the lift and press Level 10. Exit the lift and apartment 58 is the first door on your right. Use the blue key to enter.
Final Step
You've arrived — apartment 58
Apartment 58 is the first door on your right as you exit the lift on Level 10. Use your blue key to open the door. Enjoy your stay!
